name: history-preview-integration
goal: Keep owning-workspace route types, semantic screen equivalence and real catalog screenshot projection correct after integration

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: PR65 native Hub route typing, neutral SSR attribution wrappers and historical preferred-state defaults were reproduced on actual committed source; original logs and retained proof IDs remain unchanged.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Existing standardized Pages and composition tests now cover all239 visual preview choices at all3viewports, unusable evidence, strict explicit-state gaps, historical default cards, and semantic wrapper normalization. Owning app and preview compiler/lint contexts are checked separately.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: At this actual unfixed source commit, immutable321cdd9a proves the historical default card failure. Earlier33a2ce15 proves native Hub typing and5preview choices; both are real failures in isolated original-source snapshots.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Preserve native Hub resolve calls with separate preview compiler context, whitelist only neutral SSR wrappers, align current preview choices, and let only default cards/hover previews opt into valid focused own-source captures.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Source fixes72c56e8eb and7222eac9f, restored native Hub routes, canonical preview choices and default-only focused fallback. Existing standard tests, both package checks and inspected historical before/after screenshots prove the change; audit line boundary is repaired without behavior change.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.

Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
